toegepas.na: Dit bestaan uit baie aparte dele.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is baie dele' is wooden; 'bestaan uit' is natural, and 'los' can read as 'loose', which clashes with 'stewig aanmekaar vas' two sentences later.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is baie los dele' is wooden, and 'los' reads as 'loose' against 'stewig aanmekaar vas' two sentences later.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Bestaan uit baie aparte dele' is natural Afrikaans and keeps the meaning of separate pieces without suggesting they are loose.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Same reason as above: 'los' suggests loose parts, while the lesson says the parts are firmly joined; 'aparte' keeps the meaning of separate pieces.
toegepas.fout: 'los dele' suggests loose parts in a paragraph that says the parts are firmly joined.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Keeps 'daardie ... dele' consistent with change 1 and removes the clash with the definition; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Tussen die dele is daar oop plek.
toegepas.na: Tussen die dele is daar oop plekke.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Plural matches the definition just above ('met oop plekke tussen hulle') and reads more naturally for several gaps.
toegepas.fout: The singular 'oop plek' sits loosely beside the definition's 'oop plekke tussen hulle' that the paragraph is applying.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plural names the several gaps and echoes the definition the paragraph argues from, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.voor: druk sy gewig van bo op die been en die grond van onder af terug
toegepas.na: druk sy gewig van bo af op die been, en die grond druk van onder af terug
toegepas.rede_vinder: The elided verb makes the second clause hard to parse; 'van bo af' parallels 'van onder af', and the two full clauses take the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: With the second verb elided, 'op die been en die grond' first reads as the weight pressing on both, and the clause stumbles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Restoring 'druk' and the AWS comma makes two clear clauses with the same forces in the same directions.

toegepas.voor: 'n Haai se geraamte is nie been nie, maar kraakbeen.
toegepas.na: 'n Haai se geraamte bestaan nie uit been nie, maar uit kraakbeen.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A skeleton is not 'been' but is made of it; 'bestaan uit' states the material correctly.
toegepas.fout: A skeleton 'is' not bone; it is made of it, and the original is loose about material.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Bestaan nie uit been nie, maar uit kraakbeen' states the material naturally and matches the kraakbeen glossary entry; no qualifier changes.

toegepas.blok: Wat die raam vir die dier doen
toegepas.voor: kan jy tussen die ribbes van die ribbekas deurkyk, en ook
toegepas.na: kan jy tussen die ribbes van die ribbekas deurkyk en ook
toegepas.rede_vinder: The 'en ook' phrase has no subject or verb of its own, so per AWS 2017 no comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Comma before 'en' where the second part has no subject or verb of its own.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 places no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence.

toegepas.voor: Sy nuwe dop is eers sag en hy rek
toegepas.na: Sy nuwe dop is eers sag, en hy rek
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Sy nuwe dop is eers sag' and 'hy rek dit' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

laat_vaar.voor: wat 'n raam binne 'n ander dier doen
laat_vaar.na: wat 'n raam binne-in 'n ander dier doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the form the lesson uses everywhere else for inside the body, and reads more naturally here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Binne 'n ander dier' is natural and pairs with 'buite in plaas van binne' in the next sentence; the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'nou' reads as a time word (as if the strength moved); 'hier' means 'in this case', which is the intended contrast.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Contrastive 'nou' reads naturally, while 'hier buite' reads as the fixed phrase 'out here' and moves the sense.

laat_vaar.na: Dan word die nuwe dop hard
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daardie dop' could point back to the old shell just mentioned; 'die nuwe dop' makes the reference clear and the word order is more natural.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Daardie dop' points to the new shell named in the sentence just before, and the proposal repeats 'nuwe' twice in one sentence.

vlae.teks: 'n sterk buitekant om die ruimte binne, wat sy eie vorm hou sonder 'n raam daarbinne
vlae.rede: 'om die ruimte binne' is wooden (something like 'rondom die ruimte binne-in' reads better), but the same wording stands in the study text and the glossary definition, so it should be changed in both together, not by one script edit; left for the reviewer or writer to decide.
